display.purpose: The paper title, centred in a 42rem block.

headline.purpose: Numbered section headings inside the two-column body.

body.purpose: Justified, hyphenated body text in two CSS columns; lining numerals.

abstract.purpose: The abstract in a 36.5rem measure with an inline bold heading.

caption.purpose: Figure captions below frames, table captions above tables, verdict sentences.

table.purpose: Serif table cells; numeric cells switch to 12.5px mono.

readout.purpose: Legends, column headers, protocol batches, code, pre, footer.

control.purpose: Buttons, selects and their labels on the replay.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono names above data panels only; never above a serif heading.

stamp.purpose: The rotated provenance line in the left margin.

motion.name: figure-replay-step
motion.purpose: Figure 1 draws its trace once on load, one step per interval, red line last; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: play-step
motion.purpose: Replay Play advances both columns in lockstep and pauses at the first flag.

motion.name: step-reveal
motion.purpose: Faithfulness replay only: each step row fades in and rises 4px.

components.name: Link
components.description: Underlined ink link; hover thickens the underline, never changes colour.
components.html: Read the interactive version of Figure 1.
components.css: .ds-prose { font: 400 17px/1.5 "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--ink, #141414); margin: 0; } .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Open Action Box
components.description: The paper's primary action: a serif link in a 1px ink rule box beneath the figure caption.
components.html: Open the interactive version of Figure 1
components.css: .ds-open { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #141414); border-radius: 0; font: 400 15px/1.45 "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--ink, #141414); background: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-open:hover { background: var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); } .ds-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mono Control Button
components.description: Replay controls (Play, Show all, Close): mono, square, ink border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 400 13px/1.2 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); color: var(--ink, #141414); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #141414); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); } .ds-btn:disabled { color: var(--ink-3, #6f6f6b); border-color: var(--rule, #d6d6d2); cursor: default; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mono Select
components.description: Run picker on the replay, labelled inline in ink-2 mono.
components.css: .ds-ctl { font: 400 13px/1.4 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4a47); } .ds-select { font: 400 13px/1.2 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); color: var(--ink, #141414); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #141414); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tab Row
components.description: Ruled tab row: heavy rule above, hairline below, serif tabs with an ink underline when selected.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 28px; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--rule-2, #141414); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d2); } .ds-tab { background: none; border: 0; padding: 10px 0; font: 600 15px/1.2 "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--ink-3, #6f6f6b); cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink, #141414); border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Flag Row
components.description: Five detector boxes; a raised flag inverts to ink.
components.html:
plan0
contactstep 12
jump0.02
mismatchno
gap0.01
components.css: .ds-flags { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 6px; } .ds-flag { border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d2); padding: 6px 6px 7px; font: 400 11.5px/1.3 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-3, #6f6f6b); min-height: 3.4em; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); } .ds-flag-n { display: block; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4a47); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; font-size: 10.5px; } .ds-flag-s { display: block; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-flag-on { background: var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); border-color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-flag-on .ds-flag-n { color: var(--paper, #fdfdfc); }

components.name: Protocol Strip
components.description: Declared batches; the current batch is at full opacity with an ink border, a deviation is dashed.
components.html: b1 train 5 epb2 eval fullb3 report
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-batch { border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d2); padding: 5px 8px; font: 400 12px/1.4 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4a47); opacity: .35; } .ds-batch-on { opacity: 1; border-color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-batch b { color: var(--ink, #141414); font-weight: 500; } .ds-batch-dev { border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Ruled Figure
components.description: Figure frame: heavy rule above, hairline below, legend in mono, numbered serif caption.
components.css: .ds-fig { margin: 18px 0 26px; } .ds-frame { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--rule-2, #141414); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6d6d2); padding: 14px 0 10px; } .ds-chart { height: 120px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to top, var(--chart-grid, #ececea) 0 1px, transparent 1px 24px); } .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 22px; font: 400 12.5px/1.4 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4a47); margin: 8px 0 0 46px; } .ds-sw { display: inline-block; width: 22px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-dash { border-top-style: dashed; border-top-width: 1.5px; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 0; background: var(--ink, #141414); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-red { border-top-color: var(--red, #c81e1e); } .ds-cap { font: 400 15px/1.45 "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--ink, #141414); margin-top: 10px; } .ds-cap b { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Results Table
components.description: Top, header and bottom rules only; numerals in mono, right-aligned.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 400 14.5px/1.35 "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { text-align: left; vertical-align: top; padding: 5px 8px 5px 0; } .ds-table thead th { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--rule-2, #141414); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #141414); font-weight: 600; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--rule-2, #141414); } .ds-table .ds-num { text-align: right; font-family: "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Margin Stamp
components.description: The rotated arXiv-style provenance line fixed in the left margin.
components.css: .ds-stamp-box { position: relative; height: 320px; width: 40px; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: 0; transform-origin: left bottom; transform: rotate(-90deg); white-space: nowrap; font: 500 11.5px/1 "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--ink-3, #6f6f6b); } .ds-stamp b { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #141414); }

narrative.overview:
The product is a submission, so the pages are set like the first page of an arXiv preprint: centred title block, italic byline, an abstract in a narrow measure, a ruled Figure 1 that spans both columns, numbered sections in two-column justified text, tables ruled only at top, header and bottom, a references block, and a monospaced vertical stamp in the left margin. Nothing on the page is decoration; every element is a thing a paper already has. The replay page (demo.html) is the same page turned into an interactive figure: a serif title, a ruled tab row, monospaced controls, and two ruled columns of panels.

The material is cool white paper and near-black ink. Depth does not exist; hierarchy is carried by rule weight (1.5px heavy, 1px light), by three ink tones, and by the switch from serif text to monospaced data. Colour exists once: a single red that is drawn only where a trace is flagged, as the vertical onset line in a chart or as the flagged line inside the raw trace dialog. The world refuses the hackathon vocabulary of hero lines, feature cards, gradients, rounded chips and icon rows.

Motion is a single event. Figure 1 draws its trace once on load, one step every 60 ms, and the red line is the last thing to appear; with reduced motion the final state is shown at once. On the replay page only Play moves, one step per second, stopping at the first flag. Nothing else transitions.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink: `paper` ground, `ink` text, two lighter inks for bylines and metadata.
One red, one meaning: the flagged step in a trace, never emphasis, never a button.
Serif for prose (STIX Two Text), mono for readouts, numerals, controls and labels (Azeret Mono).
Hierarchy by rules: 1.5px heavy rule above, 1px light rule below, never boxes with fill.
Zero radius, zero shadows, zero icons, zero logos.
Two-column preprint body at desktop collapsing to one column on narrow screens.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks a flagged step in a recorded trace and nothing else. If a red element cannot be clicked or read back to a trace line, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Heavy-Over-Light Rule
rules.body: Every ruled frame opens with the 1.5px `rule-2` line and closes with a 1px line (`rule` for figures and pre blocks, `rule-2` for table bottoms). Fill is never used to make a container; rules are.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text uses `ink`, `ink-2` or `ink-3` and nothing between. Metadata and labels step down one or two inks; they never shrink below 11px to compensate.

rules.name: The Serif Says, Mono Shows Rule
rules.body: Prose, headings and captions are serif. Anything read from a file, a chart, a control or a counter is mono. A number inside a serif sentence stays serif; a number inside a table cell, legend or readout is mono.

rules.name: The Italic Byline Rule
rules.body: Italic appears only in the byline, the replay subtitle, and the pending state. Bold is reserved for figure and table numbers, section headings, and the stamped category.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere. If something must read as "on top", give it a 1px `ink` border and a dim backdrop.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: The on state and the hover state are both ink-on-paper flipped to paper-on-ink. There is no third colour for emphasis.

dos: Do open every frame, table and column with a 1.5px `rule-2` line and close it with a 1px line; use rules, not fills, to bound content.
Do set prose, headings and captions in STIX Two Text and every readout, numeral cell, control, axis and label in Azeret Mono.
Do keep the preprint measures: 42rem title block, 36.5rem abstract, 1000px page, two CSS columns with a 2.4rem gap at desktop.
Do draw charts with `ink` lines, `chart-grid` grid lines, `tick-idle` for idle ticks, and a 1.5px `red` vertical line only at the first flagged step.
Do show state by inversion: active and hovered elements flip to `ink` fill with `paper` text.
Do number figures and tables and open their captions with the bold number.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by rendering the final state of the trace at once.
donts: Don't use red for anything but a flagged trace mark; not emphasis, not links, not buttons, not errors in copy.
Don't add a radius, a shadow, a gradient, a tinted surface or a second colour; the only surfaces are paper and inverted ink.
Don't colour links blue or remove their underline.
Don't add icons, logos, sponsor marks or badges; legend swatches are drawn line segments, dots and bars.
Don't animate anything except the one-time Figure 1 draw on load (60 ms per step) and the replay's Play (1 s per step).
Don't introduce a heading kicker, a hero line, feature cards or a big-number row; the page is page one of a paper.
